message: No detected input validation: The dataset class in data.py reads files directly from disk without any checks on image dimensions, dtype, value ranges, or whether cv.imread returned a valid (non-None) image.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; no remote fetching is performed, and no checksum or integrity verification is present anywhere in the code.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are assigned via simple lambda functions based on filename substrings with no validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or noise-detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset class loads images directly from disk with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs at any point in the pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are loaded via timm.create_model and torchvision model constructors with no hash checks, signature verification, pinned revisions, or controlled internal source validation.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses weighted sampling via make_weights_for_balanced_classes to handle imbalance but never explicitly validates or checks the label distribution or expected label set before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or data pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or any other adversarial attack/robustness testing framework anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although separate train/val/test splits are defined, there is no hashing, signing, or isolation enforcement of the test set, and only a single metric stream (loss) is logged without multiple independent metrics or tamper-proof mechanisms.
No detected input sanitization: The data pipeline reads JPEG files and applies torchvision transforms directly with no shape, range, or validity checks before passing tensors to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are used directly for loss computation or passed through without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or confidence threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
